approach: Static recompilation of Matrix.exe and its DivX movie libraries to C with the AntiStatic toolkit (its translator, Windows stand-in runtime and Direct3D 9 bridge on DXVK, SDL3); the project's own Vulkan renderer as an option; hand-written rewrites checked against the translation
help: Testing the driving and hovercraft levels
notes: Generally untested: played through the first levels only, not start to finish; the driving and hovercraft levels are untested apart from short scripted runs. Bring your own copy of the 2004 edition; the translation is made on your computer. Adds widescreen, an uncapped frame rate, any controller, button prompts and a level select, all in the game's own Options menu.
